scripts.dev: npm run core && concurrently -k -n server,client "tsx watch server/index.ts" "vite"
scripts.build: npm run core && npm run build:app
scripts.build:app: vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && rm -rf dist/server/core && mkdir -p dist/server/core && cp -R core/pkg dist/server/core/pkg
scripts.test: npm run core && cargo test --quiet --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc -p tsconfig.host.json
